t2.title: Governments spend more on space exploration
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should governments spend more on space exploration?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Space exploration represents humanity's greatest scientific ambition. However, I believe governments should balance this spending with earthly priorities.

Firstly, space research has produced remarkable technological innovations. GPS, weather satellites, and medical advances all originated from space programs. These spin-off technologies benefit everyday life in countless ways.

Secondly, exploring space addresses long-term survival. Understanding asteroids, finding new resources, and potentially colonizing other planets could be essential for humanity's future.

However, critics rightly point out that billions spent on rockets could address poverty, hunger, and disease. When people lack basic necessities, spending on distant planets may seem irresponsible.

Nevertheless, the investment is relatively small compared to military budgets. NASA receives less than 1% of US federal spending. Moreover, private companies are now sharing costs.

In conclusion, space exploration should continue with moderate government investment, while private sector partnerships help reduce taxpayer burden. Exploring the cosmos defines our species' curiosity and ambition.

t2.sampleB1:
Dear HubSpace Team,
Thank you for your email. I am enjoying the coworking space so far. The environment is good for working, and the amenities are useful. The location is also convenient because it's close to my home.

I think it would be helpful to have more meeting rooms available. Sometimes it's difficult to book a room when I need one. Also, perhaps you could organize more social events for members to network. That would be great.

Overall, I'm happy with the space. Thanks again!
t2.sampleB2: Great topic — I've been chewing this over for a while, so I'm curious where everyone else stands. On the one hand, I completely get the objection. With so many people struggling to make ends meet, pouring billions into rockets can feel hard to swallow. That kind of money could go a long way tackling poverty and disease right here at home. That said, I lean towards spending more. For starters, space research pays off in ways most of us never notice — GPS, weather forecasting and heaps of medical breakthroughs all came out of it. What's more, learning to live beyond our planet may well prove vital in the long run. On top of that, the sums involved are tiny next to military budgets, and private firms like SpaceX are now footing much of the bill. So it isn't really space versus schools. For me, the sensible path is steady, measured investment rather than throwing money at it. Curiosity is what pushes us forward, after all. What do you all reckon — is it money well spent, or a luxury we simply can't afford right now?
t2.uzSample:
Kosmik tadqiqotlar insoniyatning eng buyuk ilmiy intilishlarini ifodalaydi. Biroq, men hukumatlar bu xarajatlarni yer yuzidagi ustuvor vazifalar bilan muvozanatlashtirishlari kerak, deb hisoblayman.

Birinchidan, kosmik tadqiqotlar ajoyib texnologik innovatsiyalarni yaratdi. GPS, ob-havo sun'iy yo'ldoshlari va tibbiy yutuqlarning barchasi kosmik dasturlardan kelib chiqqan. Ushbu qo'shimcha texnologiyalar kundalik hayotga son-sanoqsiz foyda keltiradi.

Ikkinchidan, kosmosni o'rganish uzoq muddatli omon qolish masalalarini hal qiladi. Asteroidlarni tushunish, yangi resurslarni topish va ehtimol boshqa sayyoralarni kolonizatsiya qilish insoniyat kelajagi uchun muhim bo'lishi mumkin.

Biroq, tanqidchilar to'g'ri ta'kidlashicha, raketalarga sarflangan milliardlab dollar qashshoqlik, ochlik va kasalliklarni bartaraf etishi mumkin edi. Odamlar asosiy ehtiyojlarga ega bo'lmaganida, uzoq sayyoralarga pul sarflash mas'uliyatsizlikdek tuyulishi mumkin.

Shunga qaramay, bu investitsiya harbiy byudjetlar bilan solishtirganda nisbatan kichikdir. NASA AQSh federal xarajatlarining 1 foizidan kamrog'ini oladi. Bundan tashqari, xususiy kompaniyalar endi xarajatlarni bo'lishmoqda.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, kosmik tadqiqotlar o'rtacha hukumat investitsiyalari bilan davom etishi kerak, shu bilan birga xususiy sektor hamkorliklari soliq to'lovchilarining yukini kamaytirishga yordam beradi. Koinotni o'rganish bizning turimizning qiziquvchanligi va intilishlarini belgilaydi.

Hurmatli HubSpace jamoasi,

O'ylaymanki, ko'proq yig'ilish xonalari bo'lishi foydali bo'lardi. Ba'zan kerak bo'lganda xonani bron qilish qiyin. Shuningdek, a'zolar uchun ko'proq ijtimoiy tadbirlar tashkil qilsangiz yaxshi bo'lardi. Bu juda ajoyib bo'lardi.

Umuman olganda, men maydondan mamnunman. Yana bir bor rahmat!

Hurmatli HubSpace jamoasi,

Murojaatingiz uchun tashakkur. Umuman olganda, HubSpace Coworking-da ijobiy tajribaga ega bo'ldim. Muhit unumdorlik uchun qulay va zamonaviy estetikani qadrlayman.

Yaxshilash nuqtai nazaridan, yig'ilish xonalarini bron qilish uchun yanada mustahkam tizim foydali bo'ladi, deb o'ylayman. Hozirgi vaqtda, ayniqsa eng yuqori soatlarda, mavjudlik cheklangan bo'lishi mumkin. Ehtimol, bosqichma-bosqich bron qilish tizimini joriy etish yoki mavjud xonalar sonini ko'paytirish bu muammoni hal qilishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, qahva yaxshi bo'lsa-da, yuqori sifatli donni yangilash yoki ichimliklar tanlovini kengaytirish umumiy tajribani yaxshilashi mumkin.

Qo'shimcha xizmatlarga kelsak, tegishli professional rivojlanish mavzularida seminarlar yoki treninglar qimmatli qo'shimcha bo'ladi. Bu hamjamiyat tuyg'usini rivojlantirishi va a'zolarga o'sish imkoniyatlarini taqdim etishi mumkin. Takliflarimni ko'rib chiqqaningiz uchun tashakkur.

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the coworking space. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear HubSpace Team, Thank you for asking about my experience at your coworking space. I am thoroughly enjoying the workspace environment. The open-plan design is wonderfully bright, and the high-speed WiFi is extremely reliable. The central location makes commuting very convenient. However, there are some areas for improvement. The meeting rooms are often fully booked, making last-minute bookings rather difficult. Additionally, the phone booths for private calls are quite limited. I would suggest adding more quiet zones for focused work. A networking events calendar would help members connect professionally. Also, extended weekend hours would benefit those with flexible schedules. Overall, HubSpace has significantly improved my work-life balance. Yours sincerely, Nigora Yusupova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi HubSpace,

I like the space. It is good. WiFi good.
The place is near my house.

More coffee?

Bye,
Nigora Yusupova
t12.sampleA2:
Dear HubSpace,

Thank you for the email. I like HubSpace. It is a good place to work. The WiFi is good and the location is good because it is near my work.

But sometimes it is noisy. And the coffee is not very good. Maybe you can buy better coffee? Also, more chairs would be good.

Thanks,
Nigora Yusupova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear HubSpace Team,

Thank you for your email. I am writing to give you some feedback about the coworking space.

I like the location very much because it's easy to get to from my house. I also think the internet is very fast, which is important for my work.

However, I think there are some things that could be better. For example, it's often difficult to find a free desk, especially in the afternoon. Also, the kitchen area could be cleaner. I think it would be good if you cleaned it more often.

In my opinion, if you improved these things, HubSpace would be an even better place to work.

Sincerely,
Nigora Yusupova
t12.sampleB2: Dear HubSpace Team, Thank you for reaching out to ask how I have been getting on since I joined. On the whole, I have been genuinely impressed, and I am glad to pass on a few thoughts. The workspace itself is bright, welcoming and easy to reach, and the fast, reliable WiFi has made a real difference to how much I get through each day. After months of working alone at home, the friendly buzz here has been a breath of fresh air. That said, there is still some room for improvement. The meeting rooms are nearly always fully booked, so I would suggest adding one or two more, along with a handful of quiet zones for tasks that call for real focus. A regular round of networking events would help members get to know one another too. Overall, I could not be happier. Keep up the good work! Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev

Umuman olganda, HubSpace mening ish va hayot muvozanatimni sezilarli darajada yaxshiladi.

Hurmat bilan,
Nigora Yusupova

Biroq, menimcha, yaxshilanish mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar mavjud. Birinchidan, shovqin darajasi ba'zan, ayniqsa eng yuqori soatlarda, xalaqit berishi mumkin.
